primary_keyword: health and wellness app store conversion

facts.claim: Health and fitness apps show a 4% to 8% impression-to-page-view rate and 25% to 40% page-view-to-install
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: Health & Fitness typically shows 4-8% IPV rate and 25-40% page view to install rate, with 1-3% impression to install.

facts.claim: Medical has the highest iOS install rate by category at 7.8% and entertainment the lowest at 1.1%
facts.source_title: Average App Conversion Rate per Category
facts.excerpt: Medical had the highest install rate by category on iOS at 7.8%, while entertainment had the lowest at 1.1%.

facts.claim: US App Store search install medians span 2.6% to 12.4% across top-level categories, against 0.1% to 2.5% from browse
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: In August 2026, U.S. App Store Search medians spanned 2.6% to 12.4% across top-level categories, while Browse produced 0.1% to 2.5%.

facts.claim: Health and fitness apps retain a median 25% at day 1, 10% at day 7 and 5% at day 30, with strong performers at 35-45%, 15-22% and 8-12%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Health and fitness apps: strong performers 35-45% Day-1, 15-22% Day-7, 8-12% Day-30; medians 25%, 10% and 5%.

facts.claim: Across 31 app categories worldwide, 25.3% of users return on day 1 and average retention falls to 5.7% by day 30
facts.excerpt: Only 25.3% of mobile app users return on Day 1, with average retention falling to 5.7% by Day 30 across 31 app categories worldwide.

facts.claim: Median revenue per install at day 60 is 0.34 dollars across categories, with 0.66 and above indicating strong 60-day monetisation
facts.excerpt: Average revenue per install at Day 60 has a $0.34 median across all categories, with $0.66+ indicating strong 60-day monetization.
